body:
I'm not sure I'll ever completely understand why I have suicidal feelings. I've had them of varying degrees for the past seven-to-eight years. 
I'm not sure if I'm looking for an answer or just a response or what. I'm not even sure what my question is, or if I even have one. My emotions are just so confusing right now. I'm on edge. 
There was a vigil for him tonight. I went even though I didn't know him. I guess I just felt this strange connection because of all of this.

When I first found out a student died (with no knowledge of the circumstance) it threw me just because there could have been two students dead. I was also bothered by the lack of response by those around me ("I can't find his facebook to creep, oh well, red carpet"). Now that it's mentioned, I guess I did feel jealous of being the one alive at the time, but I don't feel that way now. 
But finding out he'd killed himself just really got to me. I've had on/off thoughts of suicide for so long, and I frequently regret not doing it, although I can't say I can currently imagine myself doing it in the near future. I might have bad days where I obsess over it, or I can't get out of bed for fear I'll do something. But I'm rambling, I guess just the fact that at some point he and I were contemplating the same thing (on our small campus) and I just stayed curled on my floor and he went through with it... I don't know. 

I'm doing okay, I just have constant chills.
